video_title: NBA Season Tip-Off, Way-Too-Early Finals Picks, and WNBA Talk (with Chiney Ogwumike)

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the Chicago Bulls' playoff potential
quotes.excerpt: I'm not so sure the Bulls won't be in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: I'm not so sure the Bulls won't be in the playoffs. The way he plays and the right spot doing that, the traditional way, and then he's able to get offensive rebounds, he's going to account for 12 to 15 points that don't even have nothing to do with him.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on the Boston Celtics' new-look roster
quotes.excerpt: I think that Boston's system is something that works almost care-free throughout the regular season.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I think that Boston's system is something that works almost care-free throughout the regular season. I think it's going to be real plug-and-play with Paul George as long as he can stay healthy. I don't think it's going to be as good as with Jaylen Brown. I think that's somebody you have to recover from losing, but it's not going to be an off-brand of basketball. It's just going to be different. I think it's going to be obvious you don't have Jaylen Brown, but once you figure out who shoots your 911 shots, I think that Boston's going to look exactly how they look because they live and die by the three.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: You think it's going to be worse or better defensively or offensively?

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Offensively, I think it's going to be fine because they're going to get them up. They're going to get shots up. It's just dependent on if they make or miss. They've always played against the ball, either rip and go or shot-fake drive, but they're going to penetrate and kick. But they're looking for threes, so as much as they can drive to the baseline and get that rotation going, they're going to do it.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert and Arhii Shumpert on Jalen Duren's potential
quotes.excerpt: Duren looked like a 200 million dollar man.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Shout out to Kyle Gordon though, too, with the three sacks. That man, our nickelback, we just got him back. He ain't played in like two years, for real for real, and yeah, the man came back with three sacks, man.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Shout out to my dog, man. Let's get into the first quarter, man. Let's take a look at the NBA's opening day games tipping off today. The Boston Celtics face the Detroit Pistons in Detroit. What are we looking to see from the Celtics' new-look roster? And what do we expect from Cade and Duren today and for the rest of the season?

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: I saw him and Jalen Duren. I saw him, like the type of shit he was doing, Duren looked like a 200 million dollar man.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: That's what I'm saying. Duren looked like a 200 million dollar man. That's what I was about to say, like, are you worth exactly what you thought you were? He might be who he say he is.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert on Caleb Wilson's shooting ability
quotes.excerpt: I didn't even know he could shoot the three like this or have the confidence to pull it.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Did we keep asking for this? Like, we need that, and it's like, bro, this is a talent. Yes. I didn't even know he could shoot the three like this or have the confidence to pull it like this. He will pull that three in a fucking heartbeat.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: And he'll do it, too, off of a made basket on him.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on the WNBA's top defensive teams
quotes.excerpt: It is all about defense. These are the top defensive teams in the WNBA.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: The finals are underway now. Can you tell us what you're seeing both out of the Valkyries and the Dream so far that you like?

text_blocks.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
text_blocks.text: So, this is the most Iman Shumpert WNBA Finals in history because it is all about defense. These are the top defensive teams in the WNBA in the regular season. The Golden State Valkyries led the league in defense. In the postseason, the Atlanta Dream led the league in defense, which is why we saw the worst shooting percentages ever in history in Game 1. I think they averaged around collectively 32 percent. But, you know, after the game I hit up my sister, who was there in Golden State at Ball Hall, and I was just telling her, I was like, Neka, that game was so bad in some ways that it was good. Meaning, there were a lot of missed shots, but you would have never known because these are ladies that are competing. They're playing defense and also, let's be real here, because you talked about the format being different, it being best of three, best of five, best of seven, right? They had eight days off in between games. Anytime you're out for eight days, you're not going to shoot the ball really well.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on her WNBA commissioner relationship and growth
quotes.excerpt: I really have appreciated her time as commissioner. I know a lot of times people focus on how things end.
quotes.quote: Kathy and I have a really good relationship and I'm grateful for that because as someone in the media, I often have to be in the position of speaking on behalf of the WNBA, the players' point of view, the owners' point of view, the league, its growth overall. It was nice to have that communication with her. And even to this day, we text and I really have appreciated her time as commissioner. I know a lot of times people focus on how things end, but I think it's very important to look at the beginning of her tenure because the WNBA was in the biggest growth moment ever when she came in. It was right before COVID. She had to lead in a very, very difficult time.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: Chiney Ogwumike on Adam Silver's WNBA commissioner appointment
quotes.excerpt: The first step that I knew that this was going to be a good change for the WNBA was when Adam Silver changed the position from it being president of the WNBA to commissioner.
quotes.quote: I always tell people the first step that I knew that this was going to be a good change for the WNBA was when Adam Silver changed the position from it being president of the WNBA to commissioner. And to me, she's the first ever commissioner in WNBA history. It signaled that the WNBA is standing on its own, that it's a league that is going to get its own, meaning that it's going to pursue business opportunities that speak to women. It's going to pursue audiences that more authentically represent the basketball that is on the floor.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert and Arhii Shumpert on Timberwolves championship potential
quotes.excerpt: I think the Timberwolves have a real authentic chance of winning a championship.

text_blocks.speaker: Arhii Shumpert
text_blocks.text: Dare I say it, just based off of what I seen and their excitement, I think the Timberwolves have a real authentic chance of winning a championship.

text_blocks.speaker: Iman Shumpert
text_blocks.text: This gives me like early 2000s Portland vibe where it's like they definitely have the pieces to do whatever they need to do, whatever they want to do, postseason. Will they be there? I don't know. Will they be, you know, active and ready to go? I don't know. Will they not get in trouble? I don't know. But everybody's going to want to see them play and they're going to be exciting, so I do have to say the Timberwolves.

quotes.speaker: Iman Shumpert
quotes.summary_phrase: Iman Shumpert's NBA Eastern Conference Finals prediction
quotes.excerpt: I think Miami and Toronto are going to be the last things standing on the East.
quotes.quote: I think Miami and Toronto are going to be the last things standing on the East. Something brewing in Toronto, and Giannis is just capable of leading a team so far before he needs any help. Watching Kawhi, it's just like Kawhi is exactly what they needed. The whole playoffs we watched them, it was just like he's what they need. So I look for them to go deep. And if I can't see, I'm going to say Toronto and Minnesota is going to be the championship.
